messages:
Nina R: Heads-up: AWS Marketplace invoice INV-0427-1132 shows what looks like duplicate partner discounts on several CloudBridge orders. Can AP pause payment to this invoice? :frowning:
Danielle - AP: Can you show the exact lines from the CSV? I'll open an AP ticket if it's a system issue.
Nina R: Snippet from the AWS marketplace CSV (redacted):
```
order_id,charge_type,quantity,unit_price,total
cb-ord-9981,compute_hours,80000,0.00035,28.00
cb-ord-9981,commit_discount,80000,-0.000175,-14.00
cb-ord-9981,commit_discount (partner_credit),80000,-0.000175,-14.00
```
Liam (Finance): That would lead to double discounting. Ballpark hit across the invoice batch ~ $26k. Not trivial.
Arjun S: I'll run a reconciliation against our commit_mappings table and partner_order_id. Suspect CloudBridge sent both a direct commit and a partner-applied commit flag.
ap-bot: AP ticket created AP-3478 (assigned Danielle - AP). Status: awaiting finance reconciliation.
Danielle - AP: @Rory (Finance Lead) flagging since this is >$10k. Need approval for provisional credit memo if confirmed.
Sam (Revenue): Reached out to CloudBridge procurement to confirm whether they forwarded discounts twice. Waiting on their response.
Rory (Finance Lead): Go ahead and provisionally approve a credit memo up to $26,000 pending final reconciliation. Note: include invoice INV-0427-1132 and mention 'duplicate partner commit discounts - CloudBridge' in NetSuite memo.
Liam (Finance): Action list: 1) Arjun to produce per-order delta CSV, 2) Nina to upload full AWS dump to secure S3 and share link in AP-3478, 3) Danielle to hold payment and prepare NetSuite credit memo request. I'll attach preliminary impact calc to the ticket.
Nina R: Uploading full export now and will post link in AP-3478 when ready. Also pinged CloudBridge procurement.
Arjun S: Running join now, will post results here in ~30m.
Danielle - AP: Holding payment until AP-3478 updated with finance confirmation.
Rory (Finance Lead): Thanks everyone. Keep updates in AP-3478 and confirm final amount before issuing the memo. :white_check_mark:
